title: Study Shows Prehistoric People Targeted Female Mammoths
desc: Woolly mammoths were a favorite hunting target for Ice Age people in Eurasia and North America for many reasons. A single animal would provide a large amount of meat and fat. Its hide could be used for clothing. Its bones and tusks could be shaped into tools, weapons and art. And the largest bones could be used as building material for shelters or other structures.

title: India's gross GST collections rise 15.4% to Rs 2.11 lakh crore in July
desc: India's GST collections reached Rs 2.11 lakh crore in July 2026, reflecting a 15.4% growth year-on-year. The surge in revenue was largely driven by strong domestic performance, alongside a significant 28.8% leap in import tax collections. Together, these key elements propelled the remarkable fiscal results, underscoring the continuing upward trend in the nation's economic landscape.
